name: Eliska Fortynova
original_name: エリシュカ・フォルティーノヴァ
source:
"I'm counting on you, my apprentice and servant, my beloved child."

Likes: Candies and sweets

[url=/c125620]Shinra[/url]'s master and the master of magic "Witch of the Forest". Despite having a petite appearance, she is bossy and acting arrogantly, often using her servant Shinra, as a pawn.

A so-called "Elder Loli", most of the time, she speaks like a sage, but on the other hand, she occasionally shows a childish and innocent side, only eating sweets and then getting scolded by [url=/c125618]Homura[/url].

Although she is always berating Shinra, she still cares and shows kindness towards him, even thinks of him as her own child.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://hulotte.jp/product/vision/character/eliska.html]official website[/url]]
